Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN

Meanwhile, light to moderate rains affecting Tarlac, Pampanga, Zambales, Bataan and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Carranglan, Cuyapo, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Licab, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Pantabangan, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.

🚴‍♂️ HCL CYCLOTHON – 2025
Traffic Advisory — Cyberabad Traffic Police

The HCL Cyclothon – 2025, organized by HCL Technologies, is being conducted with four categories — 51 KM, 49 KM, 25 KM, and 10 KM, and an expected participation of around 1,500 cyclists.

The event route starts from Prime Arena, proceeds towards Kollur Exit, takes a U-turn at Kollur, continues to Kokapet Rotary, and returns to Prime Arena. Participants will complete multiple loops along the 11 KM stretch during the event.

In view of this, traffic movement may be regulated along the event route to ensure the safety of cyclists and the smooth conduct of the event. Commuters are advised to plan their travel accordingly and cooperate with the traffic police on duty.

— Cyberabad Traffic Police
